mentions.name: Boone Rankings
mentions.description: A fantasy football rankings web app built with Claude Code that presents player rankings in a cleaner layout. It has drawn heavy weekly traffic from the fantasy football subreddit, and Yahoo's site layout changes broke its automation.
mentions.problem: Yahoo changing and improving their site layout ruined the app's automation.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a fantasy football rankings app using claude code, and it has been blowing up in the fantasy football subreddit. Funny enough, it's forcing Yahoo to change their site and improve their layout which ruined all my automation. Surprised how much traffic it's receiving every week just for a better layout.

https://boonerankings.com/
